description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

The Role and Impact:

As a Software Technical Consulting Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in enabling software developers to succeed with Intel platforms. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve providing hands-on technical assistance, supporting developers in optimizing software applications, and delivering impactful training sessions. By leveraging your expertise, you will directly contribute to the success of Intel's AI solutions and development tools empowering innovation.
  
  
Business Group:

The Software Technical Consulting Engineer role is part of the Data Center Software team. Join a group focused on solving meaningful technical challenges and shaping the future of software development for AI, and beyond.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:

  

* Own technical support and provide hands-on deployment help to strategic customers on Enterprise AI (RAG, inference), Intel developer tools(Compilers, Libraries), and related software solutions for US, EMEA and APAC customers.
* Serve as a primary support-queue owner for customer intake, environment collection, installation and access issues, baseline troubleshooting, issue reproduction, and customer communications.
* Partner with peers for complex issues, including deeper troubleshooting, issue reproduction, workaround development, and workload or product-specific analysis.
* Support customer deployment and getting-started requests, maintain case ownership against defined SLAs, and convert recurring/resolved issues into FAQs, known issues, and reusable support documentation.
* Coordinate with named engineering owners on engineering disposition, workarounds, fixes, and release plans while maintaining customer communication through closure.
* Help develop and adopt AI-assisted support workflows using existing capabilities for activities such as case summarization, routing, duplicate detection, knowledge suggestions, draft responses, backlog reporting, and identification of stale cases or SLA risk, with human review of customer-facing actions.
* Help track support metrics such as response time, backlog health, escalation aging, and customer-update cadence. The Poland location provides EMEA coverage with useful overlap into APAC and AMR time zones.
* Partner across Customer Success, product specialists, engineering, product teams, IT, and account teams to provide a consistent support experience and ensure customer learnings flow back into product improvements and documentation.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Required qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5 years of experience in customer-facing technical support or support engineering, ideally involving developer tools and direct interaction with customers.
* Understanding of the end-to-end support lifecycle, including request intake, issue triage, prioritization, investigation, escalation, customer communication, and closure.
* Working knowledge of compilers, libraries, analyzers, or related software development tools, with the ability to investigate customer issues and coordinate with technical experts.
* Solid understanding of software development principles and practical familiarity with Python and C++ for troubleshooting, reproducing issues, and validating solutions.
* Familiarity with AI deployment fundamentals, including RAG, inference, and LLM APIs.
* Ability to manage multiple customer cases, track ownership and progress, maintain clear documentation, and follow through to resolution.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate across teams in a fast-paced technical environment.  

Preferred qualifications:

  

* Experience with Intel Software Development tools: Intel Compilers(C++/DPC++), Libraries(MPI, oneMKL, IPP), Profilers (VTune/SEP/EMON), debuggers or cluster schedulers.
* Working knowledge of compilers and the build/run toolchain (C/C++, Fortran or DPC++).
* Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions
* Hands-on experience building or tuning AI agents, prompt workflows or MCP or tool-calling integrations for triage.
* Experience with case-management systems, knowledge bases, escalation procedures, and service-level expectations.
* Experience identifying recurring customer issues and recommending improvements to support workflows, documentation, and self-service resources.
Customer-facing experience with strategic or scale accounts.

* Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures, and employee welfare activities.
* Coordinate performance appraisal documentation and employee feedback processes.
* Address routine employee queries and escalate matters requiring management attention.
* Support training and skill development activities.

**5. HR Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare recruitment status reports, attendance summaries, and monthly HR reports.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Good organizational, interpersonal, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned HR responsibilities.

* Familiarity with technical positions such as mechanical engineers, CAD designers, production engineers, quality engineers, and technicians.
